CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_commission_list()
 RETURNS TABLE(offer_id uuid, listing_id uuid, listing_title text, deal_amount numeric, buyer_name text, buyer_phone text, accepted_at timestamp with time zone, seller_type text, seller_name text, seller_phone text, rate numeric, commission_amount numeric, status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then raise exception 'admin_only'; end if;
  return query
  select o.id, l.id, l.title::text, o.amount, o.name::text, o.phone::text, coalesce(o.accepted_at, o.created_at),
         c.seller_type, c.seller_name, c.seller_phone, c.rate, c.amount, c.status
  from public.offers o
  join public.listings l on l.id = o.listing_id
  left join public.profiles p on p.id = l.owner_id
  left join public.commissions c on c.offer_id = o.id
  where o.status = 'accepted' and (l.owner_id is null or p.role = 'admin')
  order by coalesce(o.accepted_at, o.created_at) desc
  limit 200;
end $function$
functions.name: admin_commission_list
functions.result: TABLE(offer_id uuid, listing_id uuid, listing_title text, deal_amount numeric, buyer_name text, buyer_phone text, accepted_at timestamp with time zone, seller_type text, seller_name text, seller_phone text, rate numeric, commission_amount numeric, status text)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_agents()
 RETURNS TABLE(uid uuid, email text, full_name text, phone text, company text, status text, listing_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then raise exception 'admin_only'; end if;
  return query
  select x.a_id, x.a_email, x.a_name, x.a_phone, x.a_company, x.a_status, x.a_count from (
    select p.id as a_id, u.email::text as a_email,
           coalesce(p.agent_name, u.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name') as a_name,
           p.agent_phone as a_phone, p.agent_company as a_company,
           (case when p.role='agent' then 'approved' else coalesce(nullif(p.agent_status,'none'),'pending') end) as a_status,
           (select count(*) from public.listings l where l.owner_id=p.id) as a_count
    from public.profiles p join auth.users u on u.id=p.id
    where p.role='agent' or p.agent_status in ('pending','approved','rejected')
       or (u.raw_user_meta_data->>'account_type')='agent'
  ) x
  order by (x.a_status='pending') desc, x.a_name;
end $function$
functions.name: admin_list_agents
functions.result: TABLE(uid uuid, email text, full_name text, phone text, company text, status text, listing_count bigint)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_paid()
 RETURNS TABLE(email text, plan_expires_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then raise exception 'admin_only'; end if;
  return query select u.email::text, p.plan_expires_at from public.profiles p join auth.users u on u.id=p.id where p.plan='paid' order by p.plan_expires_at nulls last;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.agent_list_offers()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, listing_id uuid, amount numeric, advance_amount numeric, advance_due_days integer, final_amount numeric, final_due_days integer, valid_until timestamp with time zone, status text, note text, created_at timestamp with time zone, buyer_name text, buyer_phone text, contact_unlocked boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare paid boolean;
begin
  if not (public.is_agent() or public.is_admin()) then raise exception 'agent_only'; end if;
  paid := public.is_admin() or public.is_paid();
  return query
  select o.id, o.listing_id, o.amount, o.advance_amount, o.advance_due_days, o.final_amount, o.final_due_days,
         o.valid_until, o.status, o.note, o.created_at,
         (case when paid then o.name else 'Buyer' end)::text, (case when paid then o.phone else null end)::text, paid
  from public.offers o join public.listings l on l.id=o.listing_id
  where l.owner_id=auth.uid()
  order by o.created_at desc limit 200;
end $function$
functions.name: agent_list_offers
functions.result: TABLE(id uuid, listing_id uuid, amount numeric, advance_amount numeric, advance_due_days integer, final_amount numeric, final_due_days integer, valid_until timestamp with time zone, status text, note text, created_at timestamp with time zone, buyer_name text, buyer_phone text, contact_unlocked boolean)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.agent_respond_offer(p_offer uuid, p_accept boolean, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare n int;
begin
  if not public.is_agent() then raise exception 'agent_only'; end if;
  update public.offers o
     set status=case when p_accept then 'accepted' else 'rejected' end,
         accepted_at=case when p_accept then now() else o.accepted_at end,
         seller_note=coalesce(nullif(trim(p_note),''), o.seller_note)
   where o.id=p_offer and o.status='pending' and o.valid_until>now()
     and exists(select 1 from public.listings l where l.id=o.listing_id and l.owner_id=auth.uid());
  get diagnostics n=row_count;
  return case when n>0 then 'ok' else 'not_allowed' end;
end $function$
functions.name: agent_respond_offer

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.expire_stale()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  update public.listings set status='expired' where status='published' and expires_at is not null and expires_at<now();
  update public.offers set status='expired' where status='pending' and valid_until<now();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ begin
  insert into public.profiles(id, full_name)
  values (new.id, nullif(left(coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', new.raw_user_meta_data->>'name', ''), 80), ''));
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_agent_listings()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update public.listings l set
    agent_name = case when new.role='admin' then 'SAIR Construction' when new.role='agent' and new.agent_status='approved' then new.agent_name else null end,
    agent_verified = (new.role='admin' or (new.role='agent' and new.agent_status='approved'))
  where l.owner_id=new.id;
  return new;
end $function$
